bg.$description: Page background, a step off white so white panels and hairlines read. Only the page itself; never a card or control.

surface.$description: Panels, cards and the sticky header. Never the page background.

text.$description: Reading text, 6.4:1 on bg. Body copy only; headings use ink.

text-muted.$description: Secondary text and table headers. Never for anything someone must read to finish the task.

ink.$description: Headings, selection, caret, native controls and the focus outline. Not for body text.

action.$description: Buttons, links and status. The ink does an accent's job, so no other colour stands in for it. Status also needs an icon.

line.$description: Hairlines and dividers, black at 4%. Not for field borders, which need field-border.

ring.$description: The 1px inner ring on images, black at 6%. Images only.

field-border.$description: Text field borders only. Hairlines elsewhere use line.

grey-50.$description: Raw scale step behind bg. Reach for the role token, not this.

grey-200.$description: Raw scale step. Use it only where no role token fits, such as a skeleton block. Never for text.

grey-400.$description: Raw scale step. Fails contrast on bg, so never for text someone must read.

grey-500.$description: Raw scale step behind text-muted. Use the role token.

grey-600.$description: Raw scale step behind text. Use the role token.

grey-900.$description: Raw scale step behind action. Use the role token.

sans.$description: One variable family, self-hosted, subset and preloaded. The only typeface allowed.

reading.$description: Body copy at 16px. Not for interface text.

interface.$description: Interface text at 13px: labels, menus, table cells.

size.$description: Interface text: labels, menus, captions, buttons. Not for reading text.
Reading text and field input. Also stops phones zooming on focus.
Big headings below the display step. One per page.
Big headings from the display step up. One per page.

measure.$description: Maximum line length for reading text. Not for tables or interface rows.

1.$description: Icon to label, and tight inline gaps.

2.$description: Gaps inside a control or between closely related items.

3.$description: Padding inside rows and small cards.

4.$description: Default gap between items, and side margins on phones.

6.$description: Gap above a heading and padding inside cards.

8.$description: Gap between groups within a section.

column.$description: The one centred column. Wider layouts need a reason.

heading-above.$description: Space above a heading, so it belongs to what follows.

heading-below.$description: Space between a heading and its content.

row-pad.$description: Vertical padding in list and table rows.

display-step.$description: Width where headings move from 44px to 56px. Not a general breakpoint.

input.$description: Text fields, selects and small chips.

nested-outer.$description: The outer corner of a card holding an inner card.

nested-inner.$description: The inner corner of a nested pair. Outer equals inner plus the gap.

card.$description: The one shadow that separates cards from the page. Not for buttons, menus or text.

image-ring.$description: The 1px inner ring on images only.

button-height.$description: Every button. The tap target around it still reaches 44px.

target.$description: Minimum tap target. Pad the hit area, not the visible control.

focus-offset.$description: Gap between a control and its focus outline.

stroke.$description: Stroke width for line icons at the icon size.

out.$description: Ease out. The default for everything that moves: quick travel, then a long soft settle.

in.$description: Ease in. Only for something heading into a hard stop, such as a lid closing or a panel sliding against an edge: it gathers speed and stops dead.

press.$description: Press feedback on buttons and cards.

enter.$description: Elements entering. The default when nothing more specific fits.

exit.$description: Elements leaving, at 0.4 of the entrance.

modal.$description: Modals and sheets. The longest standard move.

toggle.$description: Switches and segmented controls changing state.

stagger-gap.$description: Delay between items in a stagger. Only for the page's one authored moment.

stagger-item.$description: Each item's movement in a stagger.

tooltip-delay.$description: Wait before a tooltip shows on hover.

loading-delay.$description: Show nothing for waits shorter than this, then a skeleton.

response.$description: Seconds. Gestures that land in open space only; never into a hard stop.

damping.$description: Pairs with response. Gestures into open space only.

scale.$description: Shrink on press for buttons and tappable cards. Not for links.

rest-opacity.$description: Underline opacity on links at rest; the full colour on hover.
